when_to_offer: only at a genuine unresolved player decision when the player has not already declared an action
duration_display: square-bracketed estimated in-world duration or narrow justified range

horizons.long: roughly 6 hours to multiple days or a deliberate skip

normal_scene_horizon_mix: include short, medium, or long horizons only when each is legal and useful
do not add a filler option merely to complete a horizon mix
crisis_rule: Do not manufacture medium/long waiting options during immediate danger; only legal crisis-resolving actions qualify.
interrupt_rule: If a choice crosses a known scheduled obligation or hard interrupt, annotate that expected boundary.
information_rule: Choices may state predictable commitments and player-known tradeoffs, but may not promise success, imply a hidden best answer, reveal unseen opposition, or encode repository-only facts.
menu_rule: Choices are concise, nonbinding suggestions with no default or recommended option unless the user asks for advice. Any legal free-form action remains allowed.
storage_rule: Never cache generated choice menus in scene state.
